segments.name: customer engagement platform segment
segments.description: Provides a cloud-based customer engagement platform that lets brands orchestrate personalized, cross-channel interactions with their customers in real time.
segments.evidence: As such, we have one operating segment, which is the customer engagement platform segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscriptions for the cloud-based customer engagement platform, priced largely on the number of consumers reached and message volume.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives revenues from customers by providing cloud-based customer engagement platform subscriptions.
